Definition

Extracted from the shipped row's source by AST (complete multi-line lambdas, phi triple (dh = phi3, g = phi3/(phi1 - i*phi2), a Weierstrass-representation identity)) and reproduced numerically against the shipped callables over the complex plane, exactly -- no scalar slack.

Sources

Weierstrass data reproduced numerically against the shipped implementation (math_art/minsurf/zoo.py, row KNOID) by sampling g and dh over rings in the complex plane at the row's default parameters: g: matches over 144 complex samples (worst 2.48e-16); dh: matches over 144 complex samples (worst 0).

  • L. P. Jorge and W. H. Meeks III, 'The topology of complete minimal surfaces of finite total Gaussian curvature', Topology 22 (1983).
  • L. P. Jorge, W. H. Meeks III, 'The topology of complete minimal surfaces of finite total Gaussian curvature', Topology 22 (1983) 203-221; M. Weber (mirror: minsurf ch222): 'A k-Noid is a minimal surface with k catenoidal ends.'
